name: own-ur-shit-dev-tooling
description: Dev-only tooling for this repo's TypeScript sources (wp-content/plugins/*/assets/ts/). Not a runtime dependency — every plugin still enqueues plain, pre-compiled .js from assets/js/ via wp_enqueue_script(), same as before. TypeScript exists purely as a dev-time authoring/type-checking layer; there is no bundler and no change to how scripts are loaded on the live site. node_modules/ is gitignored (regenerated via `npm install`), same posture as vendor/ for composer.json.
